parsed.summary: The PR introduces a legacy encoding format for session data when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1', which may break existing behavior and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The change may introduce a behavioral regression risk by altering the encoding format, which could break existing session data handling.
The PR does not include any tests to verify the new legacy encoding format, which is crucial for ensuring the change works as intended.
The approach of using a legacy encoding format is somewhat hacky and may not be the most robust solution for handling the transition to Django 3.1.
